approved_decision.rule: For careful/canonical pronunciation planning, adjacent vowel phonemes remain distinct vowel nuclei unless a later explicit sequence-specific or word-specific rule licenses another realization. G40 /y/ does not automatically become G16 /j/. No productive diphthong inventory is created by B3.
approved_decision.DAYI_effect: The A-Y-I sequence in DAYI is governed as three distinct vowel nuclei for careful pronunciation planning; lexical stress and final publishable whole-word rendering remain for B4.
approved_decision.FROZEN_evidence_effect: A-Y-A in SARADAYA and A-Y-O in TAYOVAN remain legal multi-nucleus vowel sequences.

governance_decisions.decision: Do not create automatic /y/ -> /j/ glide formation.
Do not create a general productive diphthong inventory in B3.
Fast-speech smoothing, optional coalescence and other allophony remain unresolved for future work.
Do not assign lexical stress in B3; B4 owns stress architecture and publishable whole-word pronunciation policy.
Do not change G16 romanization, DAYI semantics, HOYU numeral semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
